# Do not rules lawyer or minimod in the game.
What is rules lawyering/minimodding?
It’s when you decide you know the rules better than the other player and take it upon yourself to inform them of the rules in LOOC typically.
You are not an admin, so it is not your job to tell another player that they’re doing something wrong. Ahelp if you think a player is breaking the rules. You can’t assume you know what’s going on in the round, admins have a birds eye view.
Do not recommend we action something based on your opinion, this means do not ask or demand we ban or punish another player in Ahelp, this could result in you receiving a ban instead. Do not ask whether administrative action has been taken against another player or whether a specific player has been punished.
[bold]Disclaimer: You may help explain the rules to an obviously new or confused player. This rule applies when it's clear that there's no good intention behind the LOOC text outside of wanting to be right e.g you got cuffed and are angry so you're LOOC naming off rules.[/bold]
